summary:
Walkthrough documentation for Phase 4: Alpha QA, Benchmarking & Hardening of MemoDiary.
Details all executed benchmarks (10,000-entry database scale with <=50ms pagination and <=500ms FTS5; 200-entry ingestion benchmark with >=95% accuracy and <=10s parse time), fault tolerance tests (atomic rollback on corrupt imports, autosave crash recovery, lossless template switching across 100 cycles), privacy & offline security audits (SQLCipher ciphertext verification, HttpOverrides network quarantine, zero-internet manifest audit), and final 91/91 passing test verification with 0 flutter analyze issues.
